rationale: Evidence bundles contain output-validation.json manifest (verdict, file paths, sizes, hashes) rather than actual output artifacts (.docx, .pdf, .png, .zip, etc.)
1. SIZE: Output artifacts (PDFs, images, Office files) can be 100KB-10MB each. With 43+ packages, full artifact inclusion would bloat bundles to 100MB+.
2. REPRODUCIBILITY: The manifest records exactly what was produced (filename, size, hash). Anyone with the source code + NuGet packages can reproduce identical or equivalent artifacts.
3. SECURITY: No proprietary or user-generated content is committed to the repository.
4. SUFFICIENCY: output-validation.json with verdict=PASS + file path + size + hash provides audit-grade evidence that the program ran successfully and produced expected output.
what_is_included_in_bundle: package-manifest.json (package metadata: plugin class, namespace, NuGet package)
output-validation.json (verdict, output file list with paths/sizes/hashes)
what_is_excluded_from_bundle: Input fixture files (images, PDFs used as input)
exception_cases: Small text outputs (e.g., OCR result.txt) may be included when they are small (<5KB) and are needed for human readability of the result
Exception requires explicit annotation in output-validation.json under included_in_bundle: true
verification_path: Any verifier can check: (1) Program.cs + csproj are present; (2) output-validation.json shows verdict=PASS; (3) restore/build/run logs show successful execution; (4) output files listed in output-validation.json match expected filenames/extensions for the plugin type
